$comment: The strictest compiler base (ts.compiler.5). It holds the strict flags and nothing about modules or emit: tsconfig.library.json and tsconfig.bundler.json add those, and a package sets only lib, types and jsx. A flag only joins the list below and never leaves it (ts.compiler.2); one left off is named in leftOff with its reason, and test/compiler-flags.test.ts pins it off (ts.compiler.4).

leftOff.isolatedDeclarations: the schemas' types are inferred from the zod schemas that are generated, and a generated declaration is not written out by hand
